answer: Like rain carving hollows in ancient karst, peer attestations dissolve fraud into solid ground. In our economy, peer-validation flows through recursive trust graphs: minting identities demands cross-validating cryptographic proofs as tightly structured as a sonnet. A lone attacker deploying mimics faces superlinear collateral slashing: each fake raven perched across synthetic branches multiplies staking bond requirements superlinearly, ensuring total resource exhaustion against coordinated swarms.
